command: node scripts/start.mjs --port 0 (TREETUTOR_DATA_DIR set to a temporary directory)
initialState: copied tracked and new source files plus the locked manifests; no node_modules, dist or browser
notes: This is a supported Linux host that already has bubblewrap and Chromium's system libraries. On first start the launcher ran npm ci, downloaded the headless browser, built and served the app. The launcher also reinstalls when @remotion/three is missing, so an existing pre-3D install gets upgraded. No model inference.

rendererSmoke.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='Three.js|render sandbox|one real short sandboxed' test/videos.test.mjs
rendererSmoke.note: With the freshly installed dependencies: real sandbox restrictions, one short 2D render and one short Three.js render with a non-blank WebGL pixel check. The narration is a controlled sine tone, not native Edge output.
